title: Binary Search
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer n, the number of elements.
Line 2: n space-separated integers sorted in ascending order.
Line 3: integer target.
outputFormat: The index of target in nums, or -1 if it is not present.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^5
-10^9 <= nums[i], target <= 10^9
nums is sorted in strictly ascending order.
